name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape. Changelog (last 3): 7.263.0 — Script comments drop their inline changelog: every whole-line comment under spec/scripts and spec/bin loses its spec-path, AC and decision-id citations while keeping its reason, each file keeps at most one Owner: header line, and the code is certified unchanged; the doctrine line-budget, heading-list and sentence-pin tests retire (specs/20261024/04). 7.262.0 — Genesis now trusts its recorded facts instead of stand-ins: the MENUS gate and menus-done read the menu-written records (a hand-written menu file no longer advances the run, and menus-done names every open dimension with no record), and the design-brief and design-approval states derive from their marks alone, since the mark handlers already verify the artifacts. 7.261.0 — Mutation replay retired — the replay command, its script, corpus library and doctrine, the status-footer replay-due clause, fleet-reader's replay queries and review-legs' replay flag are removed; the escape ledger is the one ground-truth signal (ADR-0036).
